part.text: Evidence confirms: top spender from `yearmonth.Consumption`; avg price per single item = Total(Price)/Total(Amount); currency from `customers`.

input.sql: SELECT c.CustomerID AS top_customer, CAST(SUM(t.Price) AS REAL)/SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, cu.Currency FROM (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1) c JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN customers cu ON cu.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, cu.Currency
